objective.en: Map the heaviest new snow from the March 2024 blizzard so plow and power crews know where to go first.

sources.name: NASA GPM IMERG daily precipitation rate (GIBS layer IMERG_Precipitation_Rate) + NASA Terra MODIS NDSI snow cover (GIBS layer MODIS_Terra_NDSI_Snow_Cover)
sources.usage: Hazard cells = top 18% of storm-total GPM IMERG precipitation during the 13-15 March 2024 Front Range blizzard, kept only where Terra MODIS NDSI shows snow on the ground afterwards (2024-03-13..2024-03-15 (IMERG), 2024-03-15..2024-03-19 (MODIS)). eventDay = day a cell received a quarter of its storm total. The hazard cut-off is a game choice.

sources.name: Mission: Possible cloud and detectability model
sources.usage: cloudProbability (baseline 0.45 for this snow setting) and detectability are seeded educational estimates, not observations.
